BC_description: Renamed the property 'killed' to 'isTerminated' in the ExecaError class for error handling, affecting all instances where 'error.killed' is accessed.
Adaptation_method: Update all code that reads the 'killed' property on ExecaError instances to use 'isTerminated' instead. Example: if (error.isTerminated) { /* handle termination */ } // Instead of if (error.killed) { /* handle termination */ }
